name: lwe-ask
$comment: -c wrangler.toml is REQUIRED on every one of these, not decoration. Without it wrangler walks UP the tree, finds the root wrangler.jsonc, and runs its build.command (`node build.mjs`) from this directory, which dies with MODULE_NOT_FOUND. CI has always passed -c explicitly, so these scripts were broken without any run being able to notice. Found 2026-08-10 when lens-reader hit it on a real deploy.
